tools.name: submit_unreminder
tools.description: Sends a reminder to someone who has a public UnRemind.me page, on behalf of the person you are helping. It does NOT appear in the recipient's list immediately: it lands in their 'Submitted to you' queue for them to approve, edit or decline. You need the recipient's username, which the person you are

tools.name: get_submission_guidance
tools.description: Explains what happens to a submitted Unreminder, what makes one likely to be accepted, sending limits, and what else UnRemind.me offers agents. Call this if you are unsure whether or how to submit.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "submit?src=mcp-registry-submit" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_unreminder · Public sink: submit_unreminder, get_submission_guidance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_unreminder · Public sink: submit_unreminder, get_submission_guidance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
